text:
maria-partnerships: Quick heads-up — onboarding call with model provider last week surfaced a redistribution clause that explicitly disallows downloadable weight distribution for certain EU + APAC jurisdictions. They want us to still offer hosted inference and a private VPC image, but no direct downloads. Can we confirm what that means for marketplace SKUs and SI bundles?

jordan-legal: TL;DR — their license includes a geo-restricted redistribution term and a prohibition on “public distribution of model binaries.” It permits hosted serving and customer-managed deployments if we sign an addendum that limits download rights and requires audit logs. We need an annex in the contract.

sam-eng: Noted. From a runtime side, hosted API and Dedicated pools are fine. Private VPC deploy is trickier only if customers expect an installer package. If downloads are blocked we can offer an encrypted image that we deploy into customer infra (we’ve done this before).

kevin-product: Important for marketplace UX. We currently have two SKU types: "hosted" and "downloadable". If downloads are forbidden for some regions, we should add a third SKU flag like `download_restricted: true` so the marketplace hides the download option and surfaces a "request private deployment" flow.

alice-ops: Ops constraints: encrypted installer + remote deploy increases scope — we need KMS integration and a deploy playbook per customer. Timeline estimate: +2 sprints for automation and +1 security review. Also need to confirm whether partners require on-prem airgap images.

maria-partnerships: Good. Jordan — can you draft the short annex language that states geo-block + no public binary distribution but allows "customer-managed private deploy performed by Redwood or authorized SI"? Rahul/ops — what telemetry/attestation do we need to satisfy their audit requirement?

jordan-legal: Will draft. Suggest we add: 1) explicit geo exceptions list; 2) an escrow-style clause for law enforcement requests; 3) logging & attestation scope (who has access to KV keys, deploy records). Rough snippet: ```"redistribution: prohibited; hosting: permitted subject to audit logs and deployment attestation; downloads: restricted in jurisdictions X,Y,Z."```

rahul-siemanager: For SI integrations, partner SIs expect a downloadable artifact so they can validate in their lab. We can offer a signed, time-limited artifact accessible via a gated portal (one-time download with audit trail) for SI validation only. Would that satisfy legal?

jordan-legal: Possibly — limited-time, authenticated downloads for verified SI partners with NDA and logging might be acceptable. Need to include explicit permission in annex with conditions.

kevin-product: Okay — UX plan: marketplace shows "Request SI validation" next to models that are download_restricted. Clicking it triggers an onboarding form (customer + SI details). We route approved requests to Partnerships > SI to approve and then Ops triggers gated artifact generation.

sam-eng: Implementation note: gated artifacts should be ephemeral and include a hash & signature. Use existing `artifact-server` flow (expires in 48h) and tie to a ticket id. Minimal code changes: add flag in model metadata and tie to artifact service.

alice-ops: Ops checklist for gated SI artifact: KMS key, timestamped logs, per-download S3 path with signed URL, revoke capability. We also need a post-deploy attestation step where SI uploads a signed manifest we store for audits.

maria-partnerships: Thanks. Jordan — when can you share the annex draft? Kevin — can PM a minimal marketplace change? Ops & Eng estimate dates? We need to present to provider next Thurs. :calendar:

jordan-legal: I can share a first-pass annex by EOD Wednesday.

kevin-product: I'll scope a small wire + acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow.

sam-eng: Engineering PR for metadata flag + artifact binding: I can spike and have an RFC up in 4 days.

alice-ops: Ops runbook outline and KMS plan in 5 days. Need one headcount sync with infra.

maria-partnerships: Great — I'll consolidate and run a short 30m sync Wed 10:00 PT with provider on Thurs prep. Rahul — please list recommended SI partners who can sign NDA quickly. Also note embargo windows for co-announcement if they request it. :eyes:

rahul-siemanager: I'll DM the shortlist. For co-announcements, we need embargo alignment and final legal clearance 48h before public.

announce-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Partnership Onboard prep — provider annex review" Wed 10:00 PT — meeting created and invites sent. :bell:

maria-partnerships: Perfect. If we hit blockers on license language we may need to propose a minimal change to provider (allow gated SI-only downloads + audit). Will keep everyone posted. :thumbsup:
